title: Tenure Points Toward the Courtesy Share of a Northgate Card Late Fee
content:
For a courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the tenure points follow the whole calendar months from the account's opened date to today: 60 months or more grant 15 points; 24 months up to 59 months grant 8 points; fewer than 24 months grant none.

| Whole calendar months since the opened date | Tenure points |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 15 |
| 24 to 59 | 8 |
| fewer than 24 | none |

A month is whole when today reaches the same day of the month as the opened date. Hypothetical boundaries for an account opened on the 12th: on the 12th, 60 months later, 60 whole months and 15 points; on the 11th of that month, 59 months and 8 points; on the 12th, 24 months after opening, 8 points; on the 11th of that month, 23 months and none.
